title: Kim Chiu grateful as 'A Perfect Marriage' makes MMFF lineup
summary: Actress Kim Chiu expressed her gratitude as her upcoming film with Paulo Avelino, "A Perfect Marriage," has been included in the final list of this year 's Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF).
